failure_cases.expectation: Verifier fails if the p2-100 ZIP hash is absent or mismatched.
Verifier fails if the exact submission message is missing.
Verifier fails if any p2-96 allowed Opus result token is omitted.
Verifier fails if the result intake template is missing.
Verifier fails if the kit claims Opus approval before a raw result exists.
Verifier fails if the kit claims mainline readiness.
Verifier fails if the kit claims reviewed knowledge, evidence support, or action basis.
Verifier fails if the kit claims the full goal is complete.
Verifier fails if the kit instructs operators to edit old slices directly.
Verifier fails if the kit instructs commit, push, or sync.
